divideInsteadOfMultiply: Divides the average by the count instead of multiplying.
useOneFewerObservation: Uses count − 1 while reconstructing the total.
addAverageAndCount: Adds average and count as unrelated quantities.
useTotalAsAverage: Treats the total as though it were already the average.
countOffByOneLow: Returns one fewer observation than the exact count.
countOffByOneHigh: Returns one more observation than the exact count.
useAverageAsCount: Mistakes the average value for the number of observations.
forgetKnownTotalSubtraction: Returns the required total without subtracting the known total.
useKnownTotalAsAnswer: Returns the partial known total as the missing value.
subtractOnlyOneAverage: Subtracts one average value instead of the full known total.
